No new table/migration/CTR beyond CTR-025 (doc §13 defines no evidence-pack table; the pack is an assembled Evidence-layer artifact, ARCH §1.9). No raw PII (refs + correlation_id/evidence_id only, masked). CHANGE SET (all under 04-artifacts/impl/M6.2K/, carry the M6.2J tree byte-identical then add): NEW evidence/ package -- smoke_registry.py (canonical 18 smoke ids SMK-001..018 + scenario/expected doc §21 + bound test-file refs + owner/proposed status; proposed needs result OR waiver); categories.py (the 10 doc §22 categories + mandatory-content keys, English gloss with category-1 keeping the 'Screenshot/API/DB record' proof-form to match the slice exit-gate); models.py (frozen SmokeResult/CategoryStatus/GapBlocker/EvidencePack; to_public masks PII; readiness enum has NO PASS/READY member); gap_blockers.py (the canonical STANDING_GAP_BLOCKERS list); pack_assembler.py (EvidencePackAssembler.assemble -> EvidencePack: category COMPLETE only with mandatory content else INCOMPLETE fail-closed; smoke report correlation_id+evidence_id per smoke; ALWAYS merges STANDING_GAP_BLOCKERS; readiness per §4.4; records immutable posture; NO pass/ready/certify/flag-flip method). Tests T1-T6 map exit leg L1 (evidence pack ready): 10 categories fail-closed (FAIL-007), 18-smoke registry complete (proposed executed-or-waived), gap/blocker list always carries the standing blockers (but they do not force NOT_READY), pack never declares Pass/Ready and reaches OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED only when complete, posture immutable + PII-safe, and a meta-check that the carried 18-smoke suite collects+runs. Every change-set item maps to leg L1 (or the smoke re-run) and carries a rollback step (new files -> delete; no carried-forward file patched). Sole in-scope rule RULE-015 + sole fail gate FAIL-007 cited/mapped by ID. NO new migration (RULE-018) and NO new config flag. Full 18-smoke suite verified PRESENT in the carried M6.2J tree (SMK-001..015 owner + 016/017/018 proposed, all bound test files). RAN AN ADVERSARIAL DESIGN RED-TEAM (ultracode; Workflow, 9 agents, 3 dimensions each verified by an independent skeptic on the real tree + registers): the load-bearing dimension (no-self-cert/no-Pass-Ready/scope/invented-schema) came back CLEAN; the completeness dimension confirmed all 18 smokes present; 6 raw findings -> 3 CONFIRMED and FIXED (all wording/spec-consistency, none an invariant breach): (1+3) §4.2 was labeled 'VERBATIM' but is an English gloss and dropped category-1's 'Screenshot/API/DB record' proof-form -> relabeled 'English gloss', restored the proof-form to match the exit-gate, and corrected the C3 derivation; (2) the readiness predicate conflated the always-present standing blockers with completeness gaps (a literal 'any open blocker -> NOT_READY' would make OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED unreachable) -> added PLAN §4.4 stating the ONE readiness rule (standing blockers ALWAYS disclosed but do NOT gate readiness; NOT_READY only on an incomplete category / un-recorded smoke) and reconciled C6/§9/T3/T4/design-lens to it. The other 3 raw findings were REFUTED (18-smoke suite complete; RULE-018 'no new table' is the established pack convention; C1 __init__ mapping is fine). No plan-deltas beyond these review fixes. STATUS is coder SELF-REPORTED (not a gate/judge sign-off, RULE-015); the runner gate + JUDGE decide, and the M6.2K exit gate M6-P2009 checks the legs (evidence pack ready: full P0 re-run with correlation_id+evidence_id, all 10 §22 categories with mandatory content, owner package + honest gap/blocker list; every-prompt evidence; rollback). This slice NEVER declares ROAS Pass / Scale Ready / flips a flag (owner-only, doc §23); production/gateway/external_send stay immutably OFF through M6.2K and into PR/PILOT; M6-P1000 + M6-P1309 verdicts stay BLOCKED (not converted) and appear IN the pack; module boundary intact; no raw secrets/PII.
